scientific_plan.purpose: Unbiased go/no-go test for whether the unchanged semantic-online training recipe remains efficient enough to justify a long unattended continuation.
scientific_plan.pairing: Identical fresh scenario/deal stream and master RNG seed in all four raw-teacher arms, with balanced AAB/ABB exposure against the frozen DeepCrusher development opponent.
health_metrics: softmax fallback rate across all SpinCore decisions
near-uniform-under-1pp rate across all SpinCore decisions
AA preflop fold rate per opportunity
deep high-card jam rate per opportunity
deep high-card no-immediate-draw jam rate per opportunity

frozen_decision_rule.GREEN: 17315-minus-15315 paired EV CI95 low > 0 AND fallback-rate delta <= +3 percentage points AND near-uniform delta <= +3 percentage points.
frozen_decision_rule.RED: 17315-minus-15315 paired EV CI95 high < 0 OR fallback-rate delta > +5 percentage points OR near-uniform delta > +5 percentage points.
frozen_decision_rule.YELLOW: Anything else. Blind three-month same-recipe training is not authorized; only short autonomous macroblocks with repeated gates.
frozen_decision_rule.high_card_note: High-card jam, including no-immediate-draw jam, is a review surface and is not automatically classified as a poker error because pure bluffs may be correct.

exclusions: development-only while DC0 real-OpenHoldem parity is pending
no checkpoint/model selection from this run
no hyperparameter tuning after seeing this run
no silent reinterpretation of post15315 multi-rebuild stabilization
